exercises.title: Bài 1 · What does an architect do?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
An architect does much more than draw beautiful buildings. First, the architect meets the client and visits the site to study the land, the climate and the surroundings. Then the architect develops a design that balances function and aesthetics: a building must work well, and it must also look good.

The architect prepares drawings such as the floor plan, the elevation and the section. The floor plan shows the layout of rooms, while the elevation shows the facade. Good proportion and scale help the building feel comfortable to people. Some designs use symmetry, while others use irregular forms to create a modern style.

Many cities are famous for their landmarks, from old buildings with arches and columns to modern skyscrapers. A residential building must provide a comfortable interior, but a commercial building also needs to attract customers. That is why architects think about both the exterior and the interior of every project.

content.q: An architect only draws beautiful buildings.
content.why: Đoạn 1: kiến trúc sư làm **nhiều việc hơn** là vẽ công trình đẹp.

content.q: The architect visits the site to study the land and the climate.
content.why: Đoạn 1: kiến trúc sư đến khu đất để nghiên cứu đất và khí hậu.

content.q: The elevation shows the layout of the rooms from above.
content.why: Đoạn 2: **floor plan** thể hiện bố cục phòng; elevation thể hiện mặt tiền.

content.q: Some designs use symmetry.
What must a design balance?
content.why: Đoạn 1: thiết kế phải cân bằng công năng và thẩm mỹ.

content.q: What does the floor plan show?
content.why: Đoạn 2: floor plan thể hiện bố cục các phòng.

content.q: What do good proportion and scale help with?
content.why: Đoạn 2: tỷ lệ tốt giúp công trình tạo cảm giác thoải mái.
opts: They remove the need for a roof
They help the building feel comfortable to people

content.q: What does a commercial building also need to do?
content.why: Đoạn 3: công trình thương mại còn cần thu hút khách hàng.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Choosing the right material
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Every material has advantages and disadvantages, so architects and engineers compare them carefully. Concrete is one of the most common building materials because it is cheap and very strong in compression. However, it is weaker in tension, so engineers add steel reinforcement inside it. This material, called reinforced concrete, is stronger than plain concrete and can be used for beams, slabs and foundations.

Steel is lighter than concrete and can span longer distances, so it is popular for skyscrapers and bridges. Its main problem is corrosion, which means it needs protection. Timber is the most natural material and gives good insulation, and modern timber buildings are safer and more durable than many people think. Glass lets in light, but it is more expensive than brick and needs good insulation.

Today, many builders prefer prefabricated parts because they are made in a factory and installed on site more quickly. Whatever material is chosen, the structure must carry its load safely and the foundation must prevent harmful settlement.

content.q: Concrete is very strong in compression.
content.why: Đoạn 1: bê tông rất chịu nén tốt.

content.q: Concrete is stronger than steel in tension.
content.why: Đoạn 1: bê tông **yếu** khi chịu kéo, nên cần cốt thép.

content.q: Steel is heavier than concrete.
Glass is more expensive than brick.
Why do engineers add steel to concrete?
content.why: Đoạn 1: bê tông chịu kéo kém nên được gia cường bằng thép.

content.q: What is the main problem of steel?
content.why: Đoạn 2: vấn đề chính của thép là bị ăn mòn.

content.q: Why do many builders prefer prefabricated parts?
content.why: Đoạn 3: cấu kiện đúc sẵn được lắp đặt nhanh hơn.
opts: They can be installed more quickly
They are always cheaper than timber

content.q: What must the foundation prevent?
content.why: Đoạn 3: móng phải ngăn sự lún gây hại.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · From idea to drawing
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Every project begins with a brief. The client explains the needs, the budget and the schedule, and a feasibility study is carried out to see if the project is possible. After that, the concept is developed. Ideas are first explored in sketches, and then a rough draft is drawn.

Next, the design is turned into technical drawings. The site plan, floor plans, elevations and sections are produced in CAD or BIM software. In BIM, a 3D model is created, and all the project information is stored in it. Dimensions and materials are written on the drawings, and a legend is added so that the symbols can be understood. Photo-realistic renderings are often prepared, so the client can see the building before it is built.

When the drawings are completed, they are reviewed by consultants and the client. Revisions are made if mistakes are found, and final approval is given. The project is then offered for tender, and a contractor is chosen. During construction, the work is supervised, and finally the building is handed over to the client.

content.q: A feasibility study is carried out after the building is finished.
content.why: Đoạn 1: nghiên cứu khả thi được thực hiện **ngay từ đầu**, trước khi phát triển ý tưởng.

content.q: Sketches are used to explore ideas.
content.why: Đoạn 1: ý tưởng được thể hiện trước bằng sketch.

content.q: In BIM, project information is stored in the 3D model.
content.why: Đoạn 2: mọi thông tin dự án được lưu trong mô hình 3D.

content.q: The drawings are approved before they are reviewed.
content.why: Đoạn 3: bản vẽ được **rà soát**, chỉnh sửa, rồi mới phê duyệt.

content.q: What does the client explain in the brief?
content.why: Đoạn 1: chủ đầu tư nêu nhu cầu, ngân sách và tiến độ.
opts: The needs, the budget and the schedule

content.q: What is a legend used for?
content.why: Đoạn 2: bảng chú giải giúp hiểu các ký hiệu.
opts: So that the symbols can be understood

content.q: Why are renderings prepared?
content.why: Đoạn 2: phối cảnh giúp chủ đầu tư hình dung công trình trước khi xây.
opts: So the client can see the building before it is built

content.q: What happens after final approval?
content.why: Đoạn 3: sau khi phê duyệt, dự án được đưa ra đấu thầu.
opts: The project is offered for tender

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Why do we need building codes?
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
Buildings must be safe for the people who use them, so every country has a building code. The code explains how strong a structure must be, how many fire exits a building must have, and how wide the stairs have to be. Before construction can begin, the owner has to apply for a building permit, and the plans must be approved by the authorities.

Safety does not stop at the design stage. On site, workers must wear protective equipment such as a hard hat, and a risk assessment should be done to find every hazard. Inspectors visit the site to check compliance. If they find a violation, the builder must correct it, and sometimes has to pay a penalty. After the final inspection, the owner receives a certificate of occupancy; without it, people mustn't use the building.

Modern codes also require accessibility. A building should have ramps and handrails, so that everyone can use it. Good ventilation and natural light aren't compulsory in every country, but designers should include them because they improve health and comfort.

content.q: The owner has to apply for a building permit before construction begins.
content.why: Đoạn 1: chủ công trình phải xin giấy phép xây dựng.

content.q: Workers don't have to wear protective equipment on site.
content.why: Đoạn 2: công nhân **phải** đeo thiết bị bảo hộ.

content.q: Without a certificate of occupancy, people mustn't use the building.
content.why: Đoạn 2: chưa có giấy chứng nhận thì không được sử dụng công trình.

content.q: Ventilation and natural light are compulsory in every country.
content.why: Đoạn 3: không phải nước nào cũng **bắt buộc**, nhưng nên có.

content.q: What does the building code explain?
content.why: Đoạn 1: quy chuẩn nêu độ bền kết cấu, số lối thoát hiểm, bề rộng cầu thang.
opts: Which colour the facade must be
How strong a structure must be, and how many fire exits it must have

content.q: What do inspectors do?
content.why: Đoạn 2: thanh tra đến công trường để kiểm tra sự tuân thủ.
opts: They visit the site to check compliance

content.q: What must a builder do if inspectors find a violation?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nhà thầu phải sửa lỗi, đôi khi còn bị phạt.

content.q: Why should a building have ramps and handrails?
content.why: Đoạn 3: để mọi người đều sử dụng được công trình.
opts: So that everyone can use it

exercises.instruction_vi: Gõ dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc.

content.q: If land values ___ (rise), housing will become less affordable.
If we ___ (protect) heritage buildings, future generations will enjoy them.
If I ___ (be) the planner, I would build a pedestrian zone.
More people would cycle if the city ___ (have) safe bike lanes.
If public transport ___ (improve), fewer people will drive.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Planning a growing city
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
A fast-growing city faces many problems. If the population keeps growing, the city will need more housing, more roads and more utilities. Urban planners prepare a master plan to guide this growth. The plan uses zoning to decide which land is for housing, business, industry or green space.

One big challenge is urban sprawl. If the city spreads outward without control, commuters will travel longer distances and traffic congestion will get worse. Many planners say that if cities encouraged higher density and mixed-use neighbourhoods, people would live closer to work and use public transport more. A well-planned ring road can help, but it won't solve every problem.

Planners must also protect people and heritage. If the city carries out urban renewal without care, gentrification may push poorer residents out and affordable housing will disappear. That is why public consultation is important: if local people are asked for their opinions early, the final plan will be more successful and fairer.

content.q: A master plan guides a city's growth.
content.why: Đoạn 1: quy hoạch tổng thể định hướng sự phát triển của thành phố.

content.q: Zoning only decides where roads are built.
content.tip: housing, business, industry or green space.
content.why: Đoạn 1: zoning xác định đất dành cho **nhà ở, kinh doanh, công nghiệp hoặc không gian xanh**.

content.q: If urban sprawl is uncontrolled, commuters will travel longer distances.
content.why: Đoạn 2: nếu thành phố lan rộng không kiểm soát, người đi làm sẽ đi xa hơn.

content.q: Gentrification always creates affordable housing.
content.why: Đoạn 3: gentrification có thể **đẩy cư dân nghèo ra ngoài** và làm mất nhà ở giá rẻ.

content.q: What will the city need if the population keeps growing?
content.why: Đoạn 1: cần thêm nhà ở, đường sá và tiện ích.
opts: More housing, more roads and more utilities

content.q: What would happen if cities encouraged higher density and mixed-use areas?
content.why: Đoạn 2: người dân sống gần nơi làm việc và dùng giao thông công cộng nhiều hơn.
opts: People would live closer to work and use public transport more

content.q: What may gentrification do?
content.why: Đoạn 3: gentrification có thể đẩy cư dân nghèo ra khỏi khu vực.

content.q: Why is public consultation important?
content.why: Đoạn 3: hỏi ý kiến sớm giúp quy hoạch thành công và công bằng hơn.
opts: It makes the project cheaper to build
Early opinions make the plan more successful and fairer

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Chọn từ đúng
exercises.instruction: Choose the best word to complete each sentence.
exercises.instruction_vi: Chọn thuật ngữ kiến trúc – quy hoạch phù hợp nhất.

content.q: A ___ uses less energy and water and is built with eco-friendly materials.
Solar panels and wind turbines produce ___ that never runs out.
Your ___ is the total amount of greenhouse gases your activities produce.
A ___ is covered with plants to reduce heat and absorb rainwater.
The city decided to ___ its old offices with better insulation and new windows.
content.tip: retro + fit = lắp thêm vào đồ cũ.

content.q: In a ___, sensors and data are used to manage traffic, energy and waste.
Dark roads and concrete make districts hotter than the countryside, causing the ___ effect.
content.why: **urban heat island** = đảo nhiệt đô thị.

content.q: A city with strong ___ can recover quickly after storms or floods.
content.tip: resilient = đàn hồi, phục hồi nhanh.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Nối thuật ngữ với định nghĩa
exercises.instruction: Match each term with its definition.
exercises.instruction_vi: Nối thuật ngữ ở cột A với định nghĩa ở cột B.

content.b: meeting present needs without harming the future
gases released into the air
using sunlight and airflow to heat and cool a building naturally
collecting rain for later use
a device that detects changes such as heat or movement
how easy and pleasant it is to walk around an area
a system that reuses materials instead of throwing them away
a virtual copy of a real building or city, used for testing

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Quá khứ đơn và hiện tại hoàn thành
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form.
exercises.instruction_vi: Ngữ pháp: quá khứ đơn (thời điểm đã qua) và hiện tại hoàn thành (còn liên quan hiện tại).

content.q: Many cities ___ green roofs in the last decade.
content.tip: in the last decade → hiện tại hoàn thành.
content.why: Khoảng thời gian kéo dài đến nay → **have built**.

content.q: The council ___ the new bike lanes in 2022.
So far, the city ___ its carbon emissions by 15%.
content.tip: so far → hiện tại hoàn thành.

content.q: The architect ___ a solar facade for the museum last year.
Rainfall ___ more extreme since the 1990s.
We ___ the old factory into apartments in 2019.

exercises.title: Bài 2 · Điền dạng đúng
exercises.instruction: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.instruction_vi: Gõ dạng đúng của động từ (quá khứ đơn hoặc hiện tại hoàn thành).

content.q: The city ___ (install) 5,000 sensors last year.
Sea levels ___ (rise) since 1900.
The school ___ (not / switch) to renewable energy yet.
In 2015, the government ___ (launch) a recycling programme.
Smart technology ___ (change) the way cities are managed.
content.why: Ảnh hưởng đến hiện tại → **has changed**.

exercises.title: Bài 1 · Cities that learn
exercises.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.
exercises.instruction_vi: Đọc bài và trả lời câu hỏi (True = Đúng, False = Sai).
exercises.passage:
In the past, cities grew quickly and polluted the air and water. In the twentieth century, many factories and cars filled the streets, and urban heat islands and floods became common problems. Today, planners have changed their approach. They have introduced sustainability goals, and many architects have designed green buildings that use renewable energy and save water.

Several cities have gone further. Copenhagen built hundreds of kilometres of bike lanes, and many European cities have created low-emission zones. In recent years, planners have also started to use smart technology. Sensors collect data about traffic, air quality and energy use, and a digital twin lets the city test new ideas before building them. The idea of the 15-minute city has become popular because it improves walkability and reduces the carbon footprint.

However, challenges remain. Climate change has made floods and heat waves more frequent, so cities must improve their resilience. Many old buildings have been retrofitted, but millions still waste energy. Experts say that a circular economy and modular construction can help, and cities have only begun to use them.

content.q: In the past, cities grew quickly and polluted the air and water.
content.why: Đoạn 1: các thành phố từng phát triển nhanh và gây ô nhiễm.

content.q: Planners have not introduced any sustainability goals.
content.why: Đoạn 1: các nhà quy hoạch **đã đưa ra** mục tiêu bền vững.

content.q: A digital twin lets a city test new ideas before building them.
content.why: Đoạn 2: bản sao số cho phép thử ý tưởng trước khi xây dựng.

content.q: All old buildings have already been retrofitted.
content.why: Đoạn 3: nhiều tòa nhà đã được cải tạo, nhưng **hàng triệu** tòa vẫn lãng phí năng lượng.

content.q: What have many architects designed?
content.why: Đoạn 1: kiến trúc sư đã thiết kế công trình xanh.
opts: Green buildings that use renewable energy and save water

content.q: What do sensors collect?
content.why: Đoạn 2: cảm biến thu thập dữ liệu giao thông, không khí, năng lượng.
opts: Data about traffic, air quality and energy use

content.q: Why has the 15-minute city become popular?
content.why: Đoạn 2: nó cải thiện khả năng đi bộ và giảm dấu chân carbon.
opts: It improves walkability and reduces the carbon footprint

content.q: What has climate change made more frequent?
content.why: Đoạn 3: biến đổi khí hậu khiến lũ lụt và sóng nóng thường xuyên hơn.
